name: Appy Pie
description_en:
Appy Pie is a product in the No-code applications category. Its directory profile covers Application Templates, Integrations Management, App Integrations, Drag and drop Builder, Workflow Management, Web Development, Mobile Development, Debugging.

Additional listed capabilities include Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep).

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: define steps and route work through a process; inspect program execution to investigate faults; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Appy Pie 属于无代码应用软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括应用模板、集成管理、应用集成、拖放构建器、工作流管理、网站开发、移动应用开发、代码调试。

资料还列出访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：定义处理步骤并组织工作流转；检查程序执行过程以定位故障；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
